gloss: to stream; to distribute; to deliver content

definitions.gloss: to distribute; to deliver (information, news, content)
definitions.explanation: To send out or distribute content such as news, emails, or notifications to recipients.
To stream or broadcast content live or on-demand over the internet, including video, music, and live streams.

examples.japanese: ニュースを{配信|はいしん}する。
メールマガジンを{毎週|まいしゅう}{配信|はいしん}している。
examples.english: We send out a newsletter every week.

examples.japanese: {緊急|きんきゅう}{情報|じょうほう}がスマホに{配信|はいしん}された。
examples.english: Emergency information was delivered to my phone.

examples.japanese: {動画|どうが}を{配信|はいしん}する。
{彼|かれ}は{毎晩|まいばん}ゲーム{配信|はいしん}をしている。
この{映画|えいが}は{来月|らいげつ}からネットで{配信|はいしん}される{予定|よてい}だ。
examples.english: This movie is scheduled to start streaming online next month.

notes:
A compound of {配|はい} (distribute) and {信|しん} (message, information). Originally used for distributing news and information, it has become strongly associated with online streaming and content delivery.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {動画|どうが}{配信|はいしん}: video streaming/distribution
- {音楽|おんがく}{配信|はいしん}: music streaming/distribution
- {生|なま}{配信|はいしん}: live streaming
- {配信|はいしん}サービス: streaming/distribution service
- {配信|はいしん}{者|しゃ}: streamer, content distributor
- {配信|はいしん}{開始|かいし}: start of distribution/streaming

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {放送|ほうそう}する: to broadcast — traditional TV/radio broadcasting
- {配信|はいしん} is specifically for internet-based distribution and streaming, while {放送|ほうそう} covers traditional broadcast media
